slides.title_html:
MEBO Group at the
B20 Summit 2026
slides.subtitle: The B20 Summit 2026 was held from November 9 to 11 in Washington, D.C., United States, hosted by the U.S. Chamber of Commerce. MEBO Group further engaged in business exchanges under the B20 framework. In recent years, the group has remained active on international multilateral platforms such as APEC and the B20, actively promoting global business dialogue and cooperation. As Latin American representatives among B20 members, Mexico, Brazil and Argentina will also become key markets for MEBO Group's future cooperation.
MEBO International served as an official enterprise partner of APEC 2023 in San Francisco — advancing global collaboration in regenerative medicine and healthcare innovation.

slides.title_html:
MEBO International at the
23rd ISBI Congress 2026
slides.subtitle: From October 11 to 15, 2026, MEBO International participated in the 23rd ISBI Congress in Santiago, Chile. The regenerative medicine technology seminar was fully attended, with lectures by experts from China and Peru; the ISBI President, together with representatives of institutions from Africa and Latin America, visited the MEBO International booth to learn more and exchange views.
An ongoing online seminar series bringing regenerative medical technology to clinical teams across Latin America — practical sessions on chronic wound care under the APEC cooperation framework.

slides.title_html:
A Pioneer
in the Field of
Regenerative Life Science.
slides.subtitle: From diabetic foot ulcers and pressure injuries to burns, MEBO supports the physiology of tissue repair — 40+ years of regenerative medicine across 70+ countries.
